levels.name: Village

entries.speaker: Old Sailor
entries.text: The old sanctum door is locked tight. I have a key, but I have no more use for it.

entries.speaker: Old Sailor
entries.text: Take it, then. May it serve you better than it served me.

hudElements.text: Speak to the sailor, use the door console, and enter the sanctum.

startScreen.title: The Sanctum Key
startScreen.subtitle: An old sailor carries the key to a forgotten sanctuary. Speak with him, then unlock the northern door. Visual landmark: Village quest compass.
startScreen.howToPlay:
Speak to the sailor, use the door console, and enter the sanctum.

WASD / arrows move; Space jumps; F interacts; Escape pauses.
startScreen.controlsHint: WASD / arrows move; Space jumps; F interacts; Escape pauses.
startScreen.credits: Original models, textures and sound by Digital Opus Engine. Branching dialogue, inventory and level transitions.

ui.winMessage: The sailor's key has revealed the inner shrine.
ui.loseMessage: Restart from the menu and try a different route.
